article_title: Schools 'crying out' for guidance from government on AI, report warns

tasks.prompt: What is the report's main concern about AI in schools in England?
options: AI use is growing faster than schools' guidance, training and planning
Schools have completely banned all digital tools
Pupils no longer use AI outside school
Teachers have already received one national AI strategy
tasks.correct_answer: AI use is growing faster than schools' guidance, training and planning
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדוח טוען שהשימוש בבינה מלאכותית מתרחב, אך ההנחיות, ההכשרה והתכנון במערכת החינוך אינם מדביקים את הקצב.

tasks.prompt: What does the report want schools and colleges to develop by September next year?
options: A new social media platform
Their own AI strategies based on a national framework
A replacement for every written exam
A private AI company in each school
tasks.correct_answer: Their own AI strategies based on a national framework
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הדוח, מוסדות החינוך צריכים לפתח אסטרטגיות AI משלהם על בסיס מסגרת ארצית.

tasks.prompt: What does “get a grip of AI” mean in the report's argument?
options: Remove computers from classrooms
Allow pupils to use AI without rules
Bring its use under effective understanding and control
Turn every lesson into a technology class
tasks.correct_answer: Bring its use under effective understanding and control
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר השגת שליטה והבנה מעשית בשימוש בבינה מלאכותית.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “embedded AI into the curriculum” mean?
options: AI tools were hidden from pupils
AI replaced the school's entire curriculum
Only computer teachers were allowed to discuss AI
AI learning was made an established part of teaching
tasks.correct_answer: AI learning was made an established part of teaching
tasks.explanation_hebrew: embedded פירושו שהנושא שולב כחלק קבוע ומובנה מתוכנית הלימודים.

tasks.prompt: Which proposal is part of the report's 10-point plan?
options: Ofsted assessing how schools implement their AI strategies
Ending all school inspections
Allowing AI to award university degrees
Replacing teachers with chatbots
tasks.correct_answer: Ofsted assessing how schools implement their AI strategies
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אחת ההמלצות היא שאופסטד יבדוק את יישום אסטרטגיית ה־AI כחלק מביקורי הפיקוח.

tasks.prompt: What does “keep pace with” mean when the report compares education with young people's AI use?
options: To prevent pupils from using technology
To develop at a similar speed rather than fall behind
To measure how fast pupils type
To copy every new AI product
tasks.correct_answer: To develop at a similar speed rather than fall behind
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מציין התקדמות בקצב דומה; הדוח טוען שמערכת החינוך מפגרת אחרי השימוש של צעירים.

tasks.prompt: Name two recommendations from the report's 10-point plan for AI in education.
expected_points: A prime-ministerial speech on aligning education with real-world AI use
School and college AI strategies assessed by Ofsted
A mass information campaign on AI opportunities and risks
Using AI to track pupil progress through better data
A two-lane assessment system combining exams and continuous evaluation
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי המלצות קונקרטיות מן הרשימה, בלי להציג אותן כמדיניות שכבר יושמה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the report treat teacher training and critical thinking as important even though pupils already use AI?
expected_points: Frequent use does not guarantee safe, responsible or accurate use
Schools need shared guidance rather than chaotic adoption
Pupils must learn to recognise disinformation and assess AI output
AI may be useful without replacing human judgement or teachers
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהיכרות עם כלי אינה שקולה לשימוש ביקורתי ובטוח, ולהסתמך על לפחות שתי נקודות מן הכתבה.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the problem, the report's proposed response and the government's position on AI in schools.
expected_points: AI use by pupils and teachers is increasing while schools lack consistent preparation
The report calls for a national framework, training and school-level strategies
Its plan includes information, inspection, data use and assessment reform
Some surveyed young people questioned the value of education in an AI age
The government cites curriculum changes, AI tutoring tools and vocational routes
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את הדוח ואת תגובת הממשלה, תוך הבחנה בין המלצות עתידיות לבין צעדים שהממשלה אומרת שהיא מקדמת.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the article presents AI education as both an opportunity and a risk.
expected_points: AI can support tutoring, data use, robotics projects and proofreading
It may help pupils develop skills relevant to careers
Unrealistic trust or disinformation creates risks
Some young people fear AI could replace teachers or make universities useless
Safe use requires guidance, teacher training and critical thinking
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה מאוזנת באנגלית עם לפחות שתי הזדמנויות ושני סיכונים או אמצעי הגנה המוזכרים בכתבה.
